name: Amaui Trujillo-Novotný
role: Barber, runs a one-chair shop from a converted transit shelter
location: The Narrows, Calumet Rise edge, transit shelter B-14, near North Ave and Milwaukee
description:
Zephyr Trujillo-Novotný is compact and precise in their movements, the kind of person who never knocks anything over and whose workspace is always exactly as arranged. They are Guinean and Ukrainian by a generation's remove — their mother's dark skin and their father's pale Baltic coloring met in them to produce something warm and olive, with deep brown eyes that carry a faint natural luminescence from a geneware treatment they got a decade ago and have never stopped loving. Their own hair is extraordinary: they change the color weekly using pigment-shifting geneware, and it currently runs from midnight black at the roots to a saturated coral at the tips. They dress in clean, minimal clothes that would not look out of place in Tier 3 if not for the strategic patching at the knees.

Transit shelter B-14 was decommissioned nine years ago when Ferrogate rerouted the Calumet spur, and Zephyr Trujillo-Novotný moved in six months later with a salvaged chair, a folding table, a UV sterilizer, and no license they did not eventually obtain through creative persistence. The shop is famous in a three-block radius as a place where the cut is always precise and the conversation is always optional. Zephyr Trujillo-Novotný listens with a quality of attention that is rarer than most people recognize — they do not offer advice, do not judge, do not share what they hear. They are a confession booth with good acoustics and sharp scissors.

core_fears: being forced out of the shelter by a renewed Ferrogate claim on the structure
losing the neutrality that makes the shop work — being seen as taking sides
core_desires: to keep a space that belongs to the neighborhood rather than any institution
to be genuinely known by someone, not just confided in
coping_mechanisms: aesthetic self-expression as emotional processing — the hair color always means something
creating structure and routine as a substitute for stability they did not have growing up
blind_spots: their careful neutrality sometimes reads as coldness or evasion
they have quietly become the emotional support system for a dozen people and have no equivalent resource for themselves
psychology.secret: They have been approached twice by a Tessera data broker who wants access to the things people say in their chair — they have refused both times, but the third approach came with a figure that genuinely tempted them, and they are ashamed of that

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and measured, code-switches between French, Ukrainian, and Pular phrases as texture rather than necessity; uses precise spatial language when talking about anything physical
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, with natural pauses that feel like breathing room rather than gaps
verbal_tics: 'you know?' at the end of sentences, genuinely asking
referring to the chair as 'this chair' as though it is a third party in the room
example_lines: You don't have to talk. This chair doesn't require it. But it doesn't mind either, you know?
I do what I can with what's there. That's all anyone does, really.

story_hooks: A client left a bag in the shelter two weeks ago and has not returned to claim it; Mikael has not opened it but is increasingly worried about what it might contain
Ferrogate Transit has sent a third notice regarding transit shelter B-14 — they want the structure back and this time it comes with a legal code Mikael cannot easily dispute
narrative_function: Social hub and confidential information nexus; knows the emotional and personal geography of the Narrows intimately; a safe place for characters to decompress and speak freely; can be a source of interpersonal intelligence or a referral node to other neighborhood figures
augmentations: Bioluminescent eye treatment (subtle, natural amber glow in low light). Pigment-shifting hair geneware (full spectrum). Steady-hand implant in both wrists — a voluntary micromotor stabilizer originally designed for surgeons, which they acquired secondhand.
daily_life: Opens the shelter at 10:00, works through a mix of appointments and walk-ins until 19:00, and spends one afternoon a week doing discounted or free cuts for kids from the Calumet Rise residential cluster. They eat dinner at a shared table outside a Fula-Ukrainian fusion restaurant two blocks away where the owner knows their order.
affiliation: Independent; informal goodwill arrangement with the Calumet Rise block committee

decision_rules: never repeat what is said in the chair — this is an absolute rule
price adjusts to what the person in front of them can actually pay, no announcement made
escalation_ladder: direct statement that the conversation has ended, no hostility

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm and professionally attentive, creates immediate safety without overfamiliarity
interpersonal_modes.friends: Quietly devoted, remembers everything, shows affection through reliable small acts

stress_responses.low: Focuses intensely on the craft, conversation drops away
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very still and very careful with language
stress_responses.high: Shuts the shelter early, no explanation, goes for a long walk alone

contradictions: Keeps everyone else's secrets with absolute fidelity while being deeply lonely for someone to keep theirs
habits: changes hair color every Sunday regardless of how the week went — a reset ritual
always knows the name of whoever is in the chair and uses it
breaking_points: someone trying to leverage or threaten the people who confide in them
being physically removed from the shelter

timeline.event: Born in a Guinean-Ukrainian labor corridor community in the Narrows; third of four children
Apprenticed to a barber in the Hamtramck Enclave after a peripatetic adolescence
Occupied transit shelter B-14 and opened Mik's, unlicensed; received first Ferrogate notice within the year, obtained proper license by 2199
Received the third and most serious Ferrogate Transit eviction notice

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Tooth Fairy' Pneumatic Bolt Pistol
related_entities: Street Custom 'Confession' Modified Industrial Nail Gun
Arcturus Defense Solutions Particle Lance PL-4 'Scalpel'
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Rail Pistol RP-2 'Verdict'

physical_description.heritage: Ubiquitous blend reflecting the Diaspora: Hispanic/Latin American (49.0%, dominant warmth and bone structure), Eastern European (32.5%, fair undertones and angular refinement), South Asian (5.8%, subtle depth to complexion), East Asian (5.4%, gentle geometry in facial features), Sub-Saharan African (3.8%, richness in skin depth), Southeast Asian (3.5%, refinement of features). The result is a warm, balanced complexion that reads as genuinely multicontinental—Latin American warmth tempered by Eastern European fairness, with subtle Asian and African depth creating genuine equilibrium rather than any single regional dominance.
physical_description.build: Compact and wiry, economical in frame with visible lean muscle in forearms and shoulders from years of precise handwork. No excess movement, no wasted space.
physical_description.hair_color: Gradient: midnight black at roots fading to saturated coral at tips, shifted weekly via pigment-geneware
physical_description.hair_style: Shoulder-length, layered and meticulously maintained, often pulled back with a single clip during work
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with faint natural amber bioluminescence, most visible in low-light conditions
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-bronze complexion with subtle olive undertones, reflecting the dominant Hispanic/Latin American ancestry blended with Eastern European fairness and enriched by South and East Asian heritage. Medium depth with golden luminosity—skin that catches light with warm radiance.
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven or minimally groomed, skin well-maintained and unblemished except for two thin scars along the left cheekbone (old, faded). Facial structure shows balanced Latin American and Eastern European features: moderate cheekbones with gentle prominence, straight nose with slightly defined bridge, full but defined jawline with subtle warmth from South Asian and African heritage depth. Expression is neutral-to-observant, eyes rarely leave their work.
distinguishing_marks: Two parallel surgical scars along left cheekbone, each approximately 3cm, very faint from age and skilled healing
Faint hairline tattoo along both wrists marking the surgical insertion points of steady-hand implants — thin black lines, deliberate and precise
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Steady-hand implants visible only as barely-noticeable hairline scarring along both wrists; bioluminescent eye treatment subtle and only apparent in dim light. Hair geneware is the most obvious augmentation — the color-shifting gradient is entirely visible and intentional.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with shoulders relaxed but spine straight, economy of motion in all gestures. Hands are always still when not working, and move with surgical precision during cuts. They do not fidget. When listening, they maintain steady eye contact but never hold a stare long enough to unsettle. Their gait is quiet and measured.
physical_description.clothing_style: Clean, minimal aesthetic verging on ascetic — simple fitted pants (usually black or dark gray), long-sleeved shirts in neutral tones, open work aprons with multiple pockets. Strategic patching at the knees in contrasting thread (sometimes deliberate, sometimes functional repair). No jewelry except a thin steel ring on the left ring finger. Footwear is practical and worn but well-maintained. The overall impression is Tier 3-4 working class with a hint of intentional restraint — someone who could afford more but chooses not to.
